name: linkding
summary: Save, tag and search bookmarks on your own server.
description: The MIT-licensed linkding bookmark manager, packaged from its upstream container image with SQLite data in Automaton's durable app directory.

secrets.name: LD_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Password for the initial linkding administrator

settings.name: LD_SUPERUSER_NAME
settings.description: Username for the initial linkding administrator

arguments: cd /etc/linkding && rm -rf data && ln -s "$AUTOMATON_APP_DATA_DIR" data && mkdir -p data/favicons data/previews data/assets && python manage.py generate_secret_key && python manage.py migrate && python manage.py enable_wal && python manage.py create_initial_superuser && python manage.py migrate_tasks && exec uwsgi --http "0.0.0.0:$AUTOMATON_PORT" uwsgi.ini --uid 33 --gid 0
